title: 7 Bears
overview: Forget the Seven Dwarfs — here come the 7 Bears! This lovable pack of furballs is putting a fuzzy twist on the classic fairy tales you thought you knew.

title: Alien TV
overview: Alien reporters Ixbee, Pixbee and Squee travel to a lovely but odd planet called Earth, where they attempt to make sense of humans and their hobbies.

title: Ask the Storybots
overview: Based on the award-winning educational apps, the StoryBots are curious little creatures who live in the world beneath our screens and go on fun adventures to help answer kids' questions, like how night happens or why we need to brush our teeth.

title: Bad Dinosaurs
overview: A lovably mischievous Tyrannosaurus family explores their colorful prehistoric world, having slapstick fun with the silly dinosaurs who live there.

title: Chico Bon Bon: Monkey with a Tool Belt
overview: Armed with tools and engineering smarts, monkey mechanic Chico Bon Bon and his Fix-It Force help the people of Blunderburg solve all of their problems.

title: Dog Days Out
overview: When their humans are away, a cute and curious pup and his dog pals love to play with their best friends — their favorite toys!

title: Dr. Seuss's Red Fish, Blue Fish
overview: One fish, two fish, meet Red Fish and Blue Fish! From there to here — and from here to there — these friends find opposites everywhere!

title: Erin & Aaron
overview: A newly blended family and two polar opposite stepsiblings named Erin and Aaron who come together through music.

title: Gudetama: An Eggcellent Adventure
overview: Gudetama, the lazy egg, reluctantly embarks on an adventure of a lifetime with Shakipiyo, a newly hatched chick, who is determined to find their mother.

title: I Woke Up a Vampire
overview: On her 13th birthday, Carmie discovers that she's actually half human, half vampire — and that mythical powers make middle school way more complicated.

title: Is It Cake? Halloween
overview: Cake or fake? Trick or treat? Skilled bakers whip up hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal special edition of the hit competition series.

title: Johnny Test
overview: How much trouble could one imaginative boy, his faithful dog and two science-loving sisters possibly get into? Hmm, that sounds like a challenge!

title: Karate Sheep
overview: Trico is an enthusiastic sheep who loves to share new objects and ideas with the rest of the flock. This causes ruckus in the mountain pastures, which all inevitably end up at Wanda’s expense, a tough ewe whose job is to keep the sheep safe. Not a small feat, especially when Wolf is always lurking, waiting to make the most of this newfound chaos.

title: Larva Island
overview: Stranded on a tropical island, two silly larva buddies find slapstick fun in everything from discovering food to meeting new animal friends.

title: LEGO City Adventures
overview: Welcome to LEGO City, a modern metropolis filled with the fiercest firefighters, the cream of the crop cops, and so many Blockheads. Every citizen will assemble together for the most awesomely awesome adventures.

title: Man vs Baby
overview: As Christmas approaches, a blundering-all-the-way dad juggles housesitting a posh London penthouse with an unexpected pickle: caring for a lost baby.

title: My Little Pony: Make Your Mark
overview: Welcome back to Equestria, where pony magic is everywhere. With friends Zipp, Sunny, Izzy, Pipp and Hitch leading the way, adventure is sure to follow!

title: Oddballs
overview: Bubble-shaped boy James questions anything and everything that annoys him. The result? An awesome life of odd adventure with his two best friends.

title: Pokémon Horizons
overview: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

title: Sealook
overview: Set in a peaceful, icy wildlife sanctuary, Sealook is a slice-of-life, slapstick mockumentary that follows the delightfully bizarre daily routines of a group of "tagged seals." Having been marked with colourful flipper tags by researchers to observe their behavior, these round, squishy, and uniquely pattered creatures reveal a world that is anything but ordinary.

title: Sharkdog
overview: 10 year old Max and his best friend Sharkdog - half shark, half dog, all appetite. Blissfully unaware of his own strength, stealth and general sharkiness, Sharkdog often leaves a trail of chaos in his wake.

title: Shaun the Sheep: Adventures from Mossy Bottom
overview: Clever sheep Shaun, loyal dog Bitzer and the rest of the Mossy Bottom gang cook up oodles of fun and mischief on the farm.

title: Sonic X
overview: After getting stranded on Earth, Sonic and his friends team up with 12-year-old Chris Thorndyke to collect all the Chaos Emeralds and defeat the evil Dr. Eggman.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
overview: Armed with technological gear, great ideas and an unfailing sense of humour, Talking Tom and his friends are on a mission to reach stardom at all costs.

title: That Girl Lay Lay
overview: That Girl Lay Lay follows Lay Lay, the perfect hype girl and best friend that anyone could ever want from their personal affirmation app. Struggling to make her mark at school and needing a best friend to talk to, Sadie wishes upon a star that Lay Lay was real and could help teach her how to stand out. When her wish comes true and Lay Lay is magically brought to life, the two friends learn that when they are together, they can accomplish anything, and navigate life as teenagers and discover who they truly are.

title: The Bad Guys: The Series
overview: How did the Bad Guys break into the bad guy business in the first place? Find out in this hilarious prequel series set before the hit films.

title: The Big Show Show
overview: Former WWE wrestler the Big Show is out of the ring and ready for an even tougher challenge: raising three daughters with his wife in Florida.

title: The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
overview: Framed for a corporate crime, an adult Ted Templeton turns back into the Boss Baby to live undercover with his brother, Tim, posing as one of his kids.

title: The Boss Baby: Christmas Bonus
overview: Christmas Eve takes a twisty turn when the Boss Baby accidentally swaps places with one of Santa's elves and gets stranded at the North Pole.

title: The Cuphead Show!
overview: Follow the misadventures of the impulsive Cuphead and his cautious but persuadable brother Mugman in this animated series based on the hit video game.

title: The InBESTigators
overview: Four clever school kids start their own detective agency and vlog about their adventures, becoming fast friends in the process.

title: The Last Kids on Earth
overview: Young teenager Jack Sullivan and a group of friends live in a decked-out tree house, playing video games, eating candy, and fighting zombies in the aftermath of a monster apocalypse.

title: The Worst Witch
overview: Mayhem and mishaps follow young witch Mildred Hubble wherever she goes. She just can't help it! But with her friends' help, Mildred always manages to avoid disaster just in time.

title: Go! Go! Cory Carson: Chrissy Takes the Wheel
overview: From arcade games to sled days and hiccup cures, Cory Carson’s curious little sister Chrissy speeds off on her own for fun and adventure all over town!

title: Chhota Bheem Zuhu Ka Zalzala
overview: As a formidable enemy schemes to rule the world, Bheem must fight off attacks from all sides to defend the Vayu Chakra and unlock his own destiny.

title: Danger Mouse
overview: Danger Mouse is back saving London, saving the World and, most importantly, saving Penfold in brand new and fantastically absurd, energetic adventures.

title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
overview: Young Dai embarks on an epic journey to become a legendary hero, training with his loyal companions to save the world from the resurrected Demon King.

title: Edgar Rice Burroughs' Tarzan and Jane
overview: Saved from a plane crash and given supernatural powers, teen Tarzan joins forces with brave city girl Jane to protect his jungle home from threats.

title: Kid Cosmic
overview: A boy's superhero dreams come true when he finds five powerful cosmic stones. But saving the day is harder than he imagined — and he can't do it alone.

title: Legend Quest: Masters of Myth
overview: When mythical creatures come to life, it's up to Leo Teodora, Don Andrés and Alebrije -- super-secret monster hunters -- to save the day

title: Maya and the Three
overview: A spirited princess with the heart of a warrior embarks on a mission to fulfill an ancient prophecy and save humanity from the wrath of vengeful gods.

title: My Dad the Bounty Hunter
overview: An intergalactic bounty hunter takes dad duty to new extremes when his two kids accidentally hitch a ride with him to outer space and crash his mission.

title: Samurai Rabbit: The Usagi Chronicles
overview: A teenage rabbit aspiring to become a real samurai teams up with new warrior friends to protect their city from Yokai monsters, ninjas and evil aliens.

title: Skylanders Academy
overview: Follow the heroic adventures of the Skylanders team, a group of heroes with unique elemental skills and personalities who travel the vast Skylands universe, protecting it from evil-doers and showing the next wave of Academy cadets how to do things the “Skylander way.”

title: Spy Kids: Mission Critical
overview: In this animated spinoff series, Juni and Carmen Cortez must battle the evil organization S.W.A.M.P. -- without the help of their super-spy parents.

title: The Dragon Prince
overview: A young man with his brush plunges into a chaotic world and lights up the heavens. In a world where cultivators are paramount, will the vermilion bird swallow the dragon, or will the dragon transcend beyond all else?

title: A Family Reunion Christmas
overview: M'Dear and her sisters struggle to keep their singing act together before a church Christmas pageant while Grandpa teaches the kids a valuable lesson.

title: A StoryBots Christmas
overview: When Bo mistakenly thinks that her friends don't like her gifts, she heads to the North Pole to ask Santa for help making better presents. She learns along the way that Christmas is about far more than just the toys.

title: A StoryBots Space Adventure
overview: Join the StoryBots and the space travelers of the historic Inspiration4 mission as they search for answers to kids' questions about space.

title: Barbie: It Takes Two
overview: Barbie "Malibu" Roberts and Barbie "Brooklyn" Roberts chase their dreams of musical stardom.

title: Centaurworld
overview: Centaurworld follows a war horse who is transported from her embattled world to a strange land inhabited by silly, singing centaurs of all species, shapes, and sizes. Desperate to return home, she befriends a group of these magical creatures and embarks on a journey that will test her more than any battle she's ever faced before.

title: Country Comfort
overview: When an up-and-coming young country singer accepts a job as a nanny with a musical family, she finds the bond she's always missed.

title: Dragons: Rescue Riders: Secrets of the Songwing
overview: When a musical dragon with a beautiful voice hypnotizes the dragons and people of Huttsgalor, the Rescue Riders have to find a way to break the spell.

title: Find Me in Paris
overview: When Lena Grisky, a Russian Princess and student at the Paris Opera Ballet School accidentally time travels to present day, she must quickly adapt if she hopes to keep her secret and hide from the dangerous Time Collectors.

title: Holly Hobbie
overview: Holly's a 13-year-old singer-songwriter who's got her best friends and close-knit family by her side, but she's dreaming of ways to save the world - even if it's starting in her own backyard.

title: I Heart Arlo
overview: Arlo and his newfound crew set up shop in an abandoned seaside neighborhood and help bring it back to life.

title: Julie and the Phantoms
overview: Teenage Julie finds her passion for music and life while helping the Phantoms -- a trio of ghostly guys -- become the band they were never able to be.

title: Karma's World Music Videos
overview: Step into Karma's musical world as she rocks the mic -- and her curls -- for this fun and funky playlist packed with rhymes and the power of positivity!

title: Misfit: The Series
overview: The Misfits are in for a wild year as they prepare a school musical. But when the strict new headmaster bans the show, it's up to Julia to save the day.

title: My Little Pony: Tell Your Tale
overview: The Mane 5 are back! Sunny teams up with her pony pals for more adventures as they live, learn and laugh together in Maretime Bay.

title: Pet Stars
overview: Follow talent management company Pets on Q as they work with the biggest animal influencers on social media in this reality series.

title: Sing On!
overview: In this fun, fast-paced music contest hosted by Tituss Burgess, players sing their hearts out and try to hit the right notes to win up to $60,000.

title: Sing On! Germany
overview: In this karaoke competition hosted by Palina Rojinski, contestants must hit the right note for a chance to win up to 30,000 euros.

title: Sing On! Spain
overview: In this fast-paced, high-energy karaoke competition, singers from all walks of life battle it out for up to 30,000 euros!

title: StoryBots Super Songs
overview: Based on the award-winning educational apps, "StoryBots Super Songs" centers on the StoryBots, the curious little creatures who live in the world beneath our screens and help answer humans' biggest questions

title: Team Kaylie
overview: After a brush with the law, teen celebrity Kaylie Konrad swaps social stardom for court-ordered chaos as a middle school wilderness club leader.

title: The Who Was? Show
overview: Fresh voices bring some of the most famous names in history to life. A live-action sketch comedy show based on the series of best-selling books.

title: Trolls Holiday
overview: When the eternally optimistic Poppy, queen of the Trolls, learns that the Bergens no longer have any holidays on their calendar, she enlists the help of Branch and the rest of the gang on a delightfully quirky mission to fix something that the Bergens don't think is broken.
